## Course Materials

### Textbook

Oatley, Thomas. *International Political Economy*. 7th edition. Routledge, 2023.

- [Publisher website](https://www.routledge.com/International-Political-Economy/Oatley/p/book/9781032232669)
- Available through IU Library as e-book
- Purchase from campus bookstore or online retailers

### Canvas

All assignments, grades, and announcements will be posted on Canvas:

[{{< fa graduation-cap >}} INTL 503 Canvas site](https://canvas.iu.edu)

## Study Resources

### IPE News and Analysis

Stay current with global economic developments:

- [Financial Times](https://www.ft.com) - Global economic news (IU library access)
- [The Economist](https://www.economist.com) - Weekly international coverage
- [Foreign Affairs](https://www.foreignaffairs.com) - Academic-policy analysis
- [VoxEU/CEPR](https://cepr.org/voxeu) - Economic policy research
- [Council on Foreign Relations](https://www.cfr.org) - Policy analysis and explainers

### Research and Data

Useful sources for assignments and independent research:

- [World Bank Data](https://data.worldbank.org) - Development indicators
- [IMF Data](https://www.imf.org/en/Data) - Monetary and financial data
- [WTO Statistics](https://www.wto.org/english/res_e/statis_e/statis_e.htm) - Trade data
- [UNCTAD](https://unctad.org) - Trade and development statistics
- [OECD Data](https://data.oecd.org) - Economic indicators for member countries

### Academic Resources

- [IU Library IPE Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.iu.edu) - Subject-specific resources
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com) - Academic literature search
- [SSRN](https://www.ssrn.com) - Working papers in social sciences

## IPE Scholars and Blogs

Follow these scholars/blogs for contemporary IPE analysis:

- [Good Authority](https://goodauthority.org) - Political science analysis and commentary
- [Trade Talks](https://www.tradetalkspodcast.com) - Podcast on the economics and politics of trade
- [Duck of Minerva](https://duckofminerva.com) - International relations blog
- [International Political Economy Zone](https://www.ipemusings.com) - IPE-focused blog

---

## Recommended Background Reading

If you want to dive deeper into IPE beyond the textbook:

### Accessible Books

- Frieden, Jeffry. *Global Capitalism: Its Fall and Rise in the Twentieth Century*
- Irwin, Douglas. *Free Trade Under Fire* 
- Rodrik, Dani. *The Globalization Paradox*
- Slobodian, Quinn. *Globalists: The End of Empire and the Birth of Neoliberalism*

### More Academic

- Eichengreen, Barry. *Globalizing Capital: A History of the International Monetary System*
- Goldstein, Judith, et al. *The Oxford Handbook of the Political Economy of International Trade*
- Simmons, Beth. *Who Adjusts? Domestic Sources of Foreign Economic Policy*
